curation.lead:
AI Solutions 87 LLC is a Wisconsin-registered limited liability company controlled by Gregory P. Behm, a service-disabled veteran with a background spanning the U.S. Marine Corps, Lockheed Martin, Open Source Systems, and Lumina Analytics. Originally incorporated in Florida in March 2019, the company added a Wisconsin entity in January 2025 — eleven months before receiving two federal contracts from the Department of Homeland Security [Finding #4657]. Its SAM.gov-registered address is 4067 Sleeping Dragon Rd, West Bend, WI, a residential property, while its original Florida registered-agent address was an apartment in Orlando [Finding #4612].

In December 2025, the company was awarded IDIQ contract 70CDCR26D00000006 with a ceiling of $48,491,250 for nationwide skip tracing under ICE solicitation 26-SOL-DCR01 — placing it tenth among 14 awardees in a pool with a combined ceiling exceeding $1.44 billion [Finding #4610]. Its first delivery order under that vehicle, 70CDCR26FR0000015, was for $636,500 with performance listed in Boulder, Colorado — a location that matches the headquarters of BI Incorporated, a GEO Group subsidiary that procurement records show received a separate IDIQ with a $121.8 million ceiling under the same solicitation [Finding #4665]. Preceding the skip tracing award, the company also received DHS purchase order 70RDA225P00000029 for "WORLDWIDE FLIGHT DATA" valued at $30,192, funded by DHS Office of Intelligence and Analysis [Finding #4660].

Two Wisconsin LLCs — DC Gravity LLC (formed May 27, 2025) and SDNexus DataOps LLC (formed May 28, 2025) — share the Sleeping Dragon Road address according to initial reporting, though officer extraction from Wisconsin DFI has been blocked by JavaScript rendering [Finding #5058]. Roberto C Guercini is identified as a co-resident at that address; available records do not establish his relationship to Behm or to the co-located entities, and analysis of the cluster leaves the nature of these ties open [Finding #5058]. The company's website, ais87.com, was active through at least August 2025 and then redirected to google.com; certificate transparency logs show four subdomains — analytics.ais87.com, dev.ais87.com, gdc.ais87.com, and pfsense.ais87.com — consistent with active development infrastructure during that period [Finding #4657].
curation.system_role: AI Solutions 87 LLC is a small, veteran-owned federal contractor that holds two DHS awards — an ICE skip tracing IDIQ and a DHS intelligence flight data purchase order — and is associated with a cluster of co-located Wisconsin LLCs sharing its registered address.

sections.title: Corporate Structure and Registration History
sections.content:
AI Solutions 87 LLC carries two active state registrations. The Florida entity (Sunbiz L19000077469) was formed March 19, 2019, with Gregory P. Behm as registered agent at 12819 Sunstone Ave Apt 3107, Orlando, FL 32832. The Wisconsin entity (WI DFI A114809) was formed January 8, 2025 [Finding #4657]. SAM.gov lists the company under UEI RXFLA65SEJL9 and CAGE code 8DQH0, with the Wisconsin residential address as its primary location. SAM registration dates to August 20, 2019 — roughly five months after Florida incorporation [Finding #4619].

The company's primary NAICS code is 541511 (Custom Computer Programming), but it also carries 561611 (Investigation and Personal Background Check Services) and PSC code R615 (Background Investigation) — the codes directly matching the ICE skip tracing solicitation. It holds Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) certification and lists no parent company in federal registrations [Finding #4619]. Ninety days before the December 2025 ICE IDIQ, the company received DHS purchase order 70RDA225P00000029 classified under NAICS 541511 and designated "Small Business." The ICE IDIQ three months later, under NAICS 561611, carried the designation "Not Designated a Small Business" — both from the same UEI [Finding #4661]. The difference is consistent with NAICS-specific SBA size thresholds but has not been independently confirmed.

sections.title: Federal Contract Awards
sections.content:
AI Solutions 87 holds two active federal contract instruments as of the research date. The first is purchase order 70RDA225P00000029, awarded September 17, 2025, for $30,192, covering "WORLDWIDE FLIGHT DATA" with performance in West Bend, WI. The awarding office was DHS Office of Intelligence and Analysis (I&A) — not ICE [Finding #4660]. The second instrument is IDIQ 70CDCR26D00000006, awarded December 16, 2025, for nationwide skip tracing under ICE ERO Removal Management Division, with a ceiling of $48,491,250 and an expiration date of December 15, 2027 [Finding #4612].

The first delivery order under the IDIQ, 70CDCR26FR0000015, was for $636,500, priced as Fixed Price Incentive, with place of performance listed as Boulder, Boulder County, Colorado 80301 [Finding #4660]. According to procurement records, that zip code corresponds to the headquarters of The GEO Group's subsidiary BI Incorporated (6265 Gunbarrel Ave, Boulder CO 80301), which received a parallel ICE skip tracing IDIQ (70CDCR26D00000005) under the same solicitation with a $121.8 million ceiling [Finding #4665]. No subcontracting relationship between the two awardees has been documented in public procurement records; analysis of the shared location suggests a possible operational connection, but this remains unverified [Finding #4665].

AI Solutions 87 ranked tenth among 14 awardees by ceiling size. The solicitation (26-SOL-DCR01, issued November 10, 2025) drew 51 offers. The parent IDIQ was prepared by JBOUDREAUX7012 and VLEONOVA7012 and approved by SWRAY7012. Delivery order 70CDCR26FR0000015 was prepared and approved by a single contracting officer, JABYAD7012, on January 22, 2026 — the same official who simultaneously prepared and approved delivery orders for co-awardees Fraud Inc and Government Support Services on the same date [Finding #4612].

sections.title: Principal: Gregory P. Behm
sections.content:
Gregory P. Behm is the sole identified principal of AI Solutions 87 LLC. His documented career begins with enlisted service as an Aviation Turbine Engine Mechanic in the U.S. Marine Corps (January 2007 – August 2011), followed by a Master of Science in Applied Mathematics (Dynamical Systems and HPC) from San Diego State University (2015–2017). His subsequent professional positions include Research Scientist at Lockheed Martin (February 2017 – April 2018), HPC Data Scientist at Innovative HPC Solutions LLC (April 2018 – March 2019), Lead Data Scientist at Open Source Systems (October 2019 – January 2024), and VP of Engineering and Business Development at Lumina Analytics (December 2022 – January 2024), the latter two overlapping [Finding #4619].

Behm founded the Florida LLC in March 2019 while at Innovative HPC Solutions, and the Wisconsin LLC in January 2025, one year after leaving his last salaried positions. His contact number on SAM.gov carries a 407 Orlando area code. According to public records, he is a co-resident with Roberto C Guercini at 4067 Sleeping Dragon Rd, West Bend, WI — the same address used as the company's federal contracting headquarters [Finding #5058]. Federal Election Commission records show no donations attributable to this individual [Finding #4619].

sections.title: Co-Located Wisconsin Entities
sections.content:
Wisconsin registry records show two LLCs formed on consecutive days in May 2025 at what has been reported as the AI Solutions 87 address: DC Gravity LLC (WI DFI D082686, formed May 27, 2025) and SDNexus DataOps LLC (WI DFI S161072, formed May 28, 2025) [Finding #5058]. As of the research date, available records indicate neither entity carries SAM.gov registration, federal contract history, multi-state corporate filings, certificate transparency records, or a detectable web presence [Finding #5058].

SDNexus DataOps LLC is listed as a subsidiary of Cyber Intel Service LLC — a Florida LLC (L23000354944) registered in Melbourne, FL, with CAGE codes 9JLR6 and 9W7T7, and a second address in Lewis, NY. Cyber Intel Service operates under the CIS Labs brand, focuses on dark web investigations, drone surveillance, and ISR training, and shares NAICS 561611 as its primary code with AI Solutions 87. According to SAM.gov, its principal government point of contact is Derek Faircloth [Finding #5058]. Public records show no documented relationship between Behm and Faircloth, and the nature of any connection between AI Solutions 87 and Cyber Intel Service has not been established from public sources [Finding #5058].

Cross-reference of public records shows Roberto C Guercini present at the Sleeping Dragon Road address, with no independent business records, FEC donations, or corporate officer listings across any searched registry [Finding #5058]. Examination of the Wisconsin DFI entity detail pages for DC Gravity and SDNexus found JavaScript rendering blocked automated officer extraction, so the registered-agent identity for those entities remains unconfirmed from public sources [Finding #5058].

sections.title: ICE Skip Tracing Solicitation Context
sections.content:
Solicitation 26-SOL-DCR01 produced 14 IDIQ awards on December 16, 2025, with a combined ceiling of approximately $1.44 billion [Finding #4610]. The field spans established defense contractors — Capgemini ($365.8M), Bluehawk ($201.4M), SOS International ($123.2M), and B.I. Incorporated/GEO Group ($121.8M) — alongside companies holding residential or minimal-footprint addresses: Fraud Inc (apartment in Conroe, TX, SAM-registered five weeks before award), Government Support Services (residential address in Florida panhandle, incorporated five months before award), and AI Solutions 87 itself [Finding #4610]. Total obligations across all 14 awardees stood at $27.3 million as of the research date — approximately 2.5% of combined ceiling authority [Finding #4610].

AI Solutions 87 and Fraud Inc received IDIQs on the same date under the same solicitation, approved by the same official (SWRAY7012), from the same contracting office (70CDCR) [Connection #2712]. AI Solutions 87 and Response AI Solutions LLC similarly share the same solicitation date, and Response AI Solutions additionally holds task orders under the Navy WEXMAC vehicle (N0002325D0075) [Connection #2713]. The contracting structure places AI Solutions 87 within a broader set of first-time or low-footprint federal contractors receiving DHS enforcement capacity under a single procurement action, a pattern documented separately in the DHS Procurement dossier.
